headerDisplay: Homebridge plugin for Mitsubishi ductless heat pumps (MLZ/MSZ) over the Mitsubishi Comfort v3 API. Exposes each unit as a HeaterCooler with fan speed and vane control.
footerDisplay: For help and support, visit the [GitHub repository](https://github.com/ukaratay/homebridge-mitsubishi-heatpump).

pollInterval.title: Poll Interval (seconds)
pollInterval.description: Polling interval when streaming is healthy (minimum 5 seconds, default 30)

disablePolling.title: Disable Polling
disablePolling.description: Disable polling when streaming is healthy (will auto-enable if streaming fails)

debug.title: Debug Mode
debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging (requires running Homebridge with -D flag)

showHumiditySensor.title: Show indoor humidity
showHumiditySensor.description: Expose each unit's indoor humidity as a HumiditySensor service. Turn this OFF if humidity is dominating the accessory tile in the Apple Home app: Home collapses an accessory's services into a single tile and favours a sensor reading for what that tile displays, so a unit with a humidity sensor can show humidity where you wanted temperature and fan. Home's per-accessory "Show as Separate Tiles" setting is the alternative that keeps both.

showDrySwitch.title: Show Dry (dehumidify) switch
showDrySwitch.description: Add a separate Dry switch tile per unit. Off by default: HeaterCooler now carries fan speed and vane on the main tile, so the extra switches are only needed if you want one-tap access to dehumidify. Only added on units whose profile reports dry support.

showFanOnlySwitch.title: Show Fan-only switch
showFanOnlySwitch.description: Add a separate Fan-only switch tile per unit. Off by default. Note this is fan-ONLY mode (the unit runs its fan with no heating or cooling); adjusting fan speed while heating or cooling is done on the main tile and does not need this switch. Only added on units whose profile reports vent support.

exposeVaneSlat.title: Expose vane as a Slat service
exposeVaneSlat.description: Expose vane direction as a HomeKit Slats service, giving discrete tilt positions. OFF by default: Apple Home categorises Slats as a WINDOW COVERING, so these tiles join the blinds/shades grouping in your rooms and a room-level blinds control can reach your louvres. Swing on/off is always available on the main climate tile regardless of this setting. Only enable if you want fixed vane angles and accept them appearing among your window coverings.

excludeDevices.title: Hide Device IDs

items.title: Device Serial Number
items.description: Enter device serial number to hide

excludeDevices.description: Device serial numbers to hide from HomeKit (found in logs during device discovery)

streamingHealthCheckInterval.title: Streaming Health Check Interval (seconds)
streamingHealthCheckInterval.description: How often to check if streaming is healthy (default: 30 seconds)

streamingStaleThreshold.title: Streaming Stale Threshold (seconds)
streamingStaleThreshold.description: Deprecated and inert: nothing in the plugin reads this. Streaming health is decided by the Socket.IO connection state on the streamingHealthCheckInterval tick. Kept so an existing config.json that sets it stays valid.

degradedPollInterval.title: Degraded Mode Poll Interval (seconds)
degradedPollInterval.description: Fast polling interval when streaming is unhealthy (default: 10 seconds)

localControl.title: Enable Local Control (currently blocked by the vendor)
localControl.description: Control units directly over the LAN for lower latency and cloud-outage resilience. Around 2026-07-31 Mitsubishi's cloud stopped serving the two per-device secrets a unit's adapter needs to authenticate a local request (pykumo issue #78), so this cannot work at present and everything runs over the cloud. Leaving it on costs one warning and nothing else: the plugin recovers by itself if the vendor reverts. Requires a full Homebridge restart to toggle (child bridges get their config from the parent process).

localPollInterval.title: Local Poll Interval (seconds)
localPollInterval.description: How often to read unit status over the LAN when local control is enabled (default: 15)

localControlIps.title: Local IP Overrides
localControlIps.description: Optional manual { "<deviceSerial>": "<ip>" } map to skip LAN discovery for specific units (edit via the JSON config editor).

mirror.title: Device Mirroring
mirror.description: Make one unit follow another. Whenever the source changes (via any control — wall thermostat, Kumo app, or HomeKit), its full state (mode, setpoints, on/off, fan) is copied to the target. One-way; a manual change to the target holds until the source changes again.

source.title: Source Device Serial
source.description: The unit to copy from (found in logs during device discovery)

target.title: Target Device Serial
target.description: The unit that follows the source

items.helpvalue: Local IP overrides (localControlIps) are a free-form { "<deviceSerial>": "<ip>" } map, which this form cannot render as fields. Set it in the JSON config editor if you want to skip the LAN sweep for specific units. Any value already there is preserved.
